message:
Amara, Baraka and Dalia, the door seals by squeeze of a soft strip between fixed wall and moving leaf. The seal detail sketch (E59) shows double magnetic gaskets with 3 millimetre squeeze on the 800 millimetre hinged door, so warm air leakage stays small and the opening still passes a person carrying a 600 by 400 millimetre crate in the stacking crate (E36), door scale like a house door so plausible.

Amara, Baraka and Dalia, crates cannot tip into the central aisle because each shelf has a lip. The seal detail sketch (E59) shows a fixed guard rail 50 millimetres above each shelf holding 20 kilogramme ventilated crates, luggage scale per lift, while spread floor load of 2.04 kilopascals in the floor pressure calculation (E43) is about one tenth of a person standing so the skid with plywood spreaders carries the tonne.

Amara, Baraka and Dalia, the chamber stays roomy enough for air to move around produce. Inner volume of 10.6 cubic metres at 27.1 percent produce fill in the chamber simulation (E44) is small bedroom scale so air paths stay open. I am not ready, because the blocking energy mismatch objection (O1) on peak cooling and wiring with Amara and Baraka must be agreed before a vote.
